scope: Steps D1 (coxa action table, geometry only) and D2 (rule-generated H1/H2 hypothesis bindings). No CNS, no physics stepping, no admission. D3 is a separate later protocol.

sources.bodymap: malecns-v1 cache bodymap (same object as Step A motor_sets); coxa labels coxa_T<s>_<side>, coxa_abduct_T<s>_<side>, coxa_twist_T<s>_<side>
sources.body: FlyGym body from _windows_m7d_corrected_spontaneous_adapter._runtime, initial (Step B rest) pose

feasibility_inspection_before_registrati: Leg bodies per leg: Coxa, Femur, Tibia, Tarsus1-5; coxa joints are hinges (type 3) named joint_<leg>Coxa, _roll, _yaw.
Coxa actuators have ctrlrange +/-1e6 and joints are unlimited, so the existing safe_contribution_bound gives DECODER_MAX_RAD 0.25 rad.
Bodymap coxa pool names and sizes were listed for left legs; no action vector, cosine or walking range was computed.

D1.tip: origin of body <leg>Tarsus5 (the most distal leg body frame)
D1.frame: Thorax body frame; anterior = +x (Step B anterior check: Head x > 0.99 of its norm, else INCONCLUSIVE); outward = +y for a leg whose Coxa origin has y > 0 in the Thorax frame, else -y; dorsal = +z
D1.action_vector: (tip(q+0.01) - tip(q-0.01)) / 0.02 rad, one coxa DoF perturbed, all other qpos at rest, mj_kinematics; reported as (anterior, outward, dorsal)
D1.walking_range: peak-to-peak of recorded joint_<leg><DoF> over the 45 recorded samples

checks.D1a_nonzero: every one of the 18 action vectors is finite with norm > 1e-6 model length units per rad
checks.D1b_step_b_sign: anterior component of +joint_<leg>Coxa is < 0 in all six legs

D1.D1c_cross_check: reported, not a gate: per leg, the H1 swing joint (the DoF receiving the most swing pools: promotor, remotor/abductor, anterior rotator, posterior rotator; ties -> SPLIT) equals the DoF with the largest recorded walking range

D2.pool_identity: bodymap muscle name '<pool> MN T<s> <side>' with a coxa label; dense indices deduplicated per pool; body IDs from cache body_ids; must equal the audit candidate body IDs for that pool
D2.rule: cos(named action, action vector) for each candidate joint; assign to max |cos|; sign = sign(cos); |cos| < 0.5 -> UNASSIGNED; every pool to exactly one joint
D2.H2_candidates: only the joints of the pool's bodymap labels: coxa -> Coxa, coxa_abduct -> Coxa_roll, coxa_twist -> Coxa_yaw
D2.channels: per joint with >=1 pool: both signs -> antagonist_pair (coordinate_sign +1, positive = cos>0 pools); one sign only -> unidirectional_positive with coordinate_sign = that sign; several same-sign pools on such a joint are merged under the population name '<pool A> + <pool B>' (sorted)
D2.identical: if H1 and H2 channel sets are equal, H2_IDENTICAL_TO_H1 is recorded and D3 skips H2

checks.D2a_identity: every pool's body IDs equal the audit candidate body IDs; the kernel's supplemental resolver accepts H1, H2 and H1_FLIP definitions (no reused body ID, correct action indices)

acceptance.NOT_READY: any of D1a, D1b, D2a fails
acceptance.INCONCLUSIVE: kinematics/audit hash, anterior check or exact body identity fails

interpretation_limits: Named actions are literature-name readings, not measured muscle actions; rotator = swing is a stated choice with H2 as the competing twist reading.
Action vectors are local derivatives at one standing pose; muscle moment arms and attachment geometry are not modeled.
H1/H2 are labelled hypotheses, not admissions; motor coverage remains 20/42 proven.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed.
